//changelog: The default generator, not changelog-github: that one needs a GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment to resolve commit authors, which makes a release impossible to cut without one.
//: Every package moves together. The adapters are one library published under several names. A core fix that only bumps some of them would let a user end up on @oklch-picker/react@0.4 against core@0.3, which is exactly the version skew a single library does not need. Grouping them keeps one version number and one changelog to reason about.
